test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 20 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’,

A – B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A x B means ‘A is the wife of B’ and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the father of B’.

Based on the above, how is U related to Z if ‘U – V x W ÷ Y + Z’?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30c846b9ff2ba207e1d695af82791b28e53eb8feaafb87a71ff85ca49dd74512.png]

Given: U – V x W ÷ Y + Z

U – V means U is brother of V

V x W means V is wife of W

W ÷ Y means W is father of Y

Y + Z means Y is mother of Z

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a20734d775a367af650da0c829b76334a1873ba9c601880ce38c92f80b763d7.png] 

Thus, U is Mother's mother's brother of Z.

Hence, correct answer is **"Option 3".**
